definition.aggregation: pooled over a cell's four draws, unweighted mean over defined prompts, then over seeds
definition.estimator: PMD = 1 - sum_m n_m (n_m - 1) / (K (K - 1)) over a prompt's verified responses
definition.sampling: aligned eight-wide RNG blocks hashed from (domain, problem, draw), the policy registered for the frozen base-model grid
definition.streams_per_prompt: thirty-two disjoint, against eleven overlapping in the registered draws
